text:
Marta R.: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — token-ingest lag on 2026-03-20 caused ~6% undercount for a subset of customers. We need a remediation plan: invoice corrections, credits, and comms. Who owns credits + timeline? cc @Alex F. @Priya K.

Alex F.: I can own credits & invoice corrections. Can someone produce an affected-customer list + estimated token shortfall by EOD? Also, are we holding off on manual invoice reissues until backfill finishes?

Priya K.: Backfill started 02:30 UTC and is running now, ETA ~6h. I can own the customer notification template and sending once credits are confirmed. Agree — wait for backfill + reconcile before reissuing.

Chris L.: Reverted the faulty consumer change this morning. Root cause looks like an edge case in Kafka offset commit when broker timeout spikes. I'll own the permanent fix and a safer consumer retry strategy. Created ticket INF-4873 and assigned to eng-infra. ETA 3 days for fix + canary.

Sam P.: For detection, run this query to list impacted customers: ```sql
SELECT customer_id, SUM(missed_tokens) AS missed_tokens
FROM token_ingest_failures
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-20T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-21T00:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING missed_tokens > 0;
``` I'll run it and upload the CSV to the secure vault.

billing-bot: Automated preliminary report: 412 accounts flagged, projected credit ~1.2M tokens (~$12k). Backfill job id: bj-2245-01. Details: s3://redwood-prod/ingest-reconcile/2245123456/preview.csv

Marta R.: OK owners & deadlines proposal: Alex — credits & invoice corrections (estimate + approvals) due 2026-03-28; Priya — notifications draft due 2026-03-24; Chris — permanent fix & rollout plan due 2026-03-30; Backfill progress check-in in 6h from this message.

Alex F.: Acknowledged. I'll draft the credit calculation policy and the invoice patch runbook. Will require finance + legal sign-off before applying credits.

Priya K.: Draft notif: short apology, what happened, that a credit was applied, link to FAQ. Will post draft here for review in 2 hours.

Chris L.: INF-4873 updated with root-cause notes and first PR link (will add link once build passes). Plan: small consumer change + canary over 4 clusters then full rollout.

Sam P.: Backfill completed earlier than expected — finished at 05:10 UTC. Running final reconcile and smoke checks now.

Marta R.: Who can confirm reconcile success? If green, Alex proceed with invoice corrections and Priya send notif.

billing-bot: Reconcile job bj-2245-01 completed at 05:10 UTC. Discrepancy count: reduced to 0. Artifact: s3://redwood-prod/ingest-reconcile/2245123456/report.csv

Alex F.: Confirmed reconcile passed validation. I'll schedule invoice corrections tomorrow 09:00 PT and queue credits. Expected closure ETA 2026-03-29 after approvals.

Priya K.: Notification draft uploaded: https://docs.internal/redwood/finance/credits-notif-draft. PTAL @Alex F. @Legal.

Marta R.: Action summary: 1) Alex F. — credits + invoice corrections (due 2026-03-29) 2) Priya K. — customer notifications (draft due 2026-03-24) 3) Chris L. — permanent consumer fix + rollout (due 2026-03-30) 4) Sam P. — validation & metrics (done). We'll track these in the billing postmortem follow-up board and review in next billing standup. :white_check_mark:
